exposure: Supply-side factors (remote access to paediatric ART centres, lack of paediatric ART medicine formulations)
cohort: The study included 310 children with HIV diagnosis before 18 months of age, who were on ART.
finding: Overall survival was good for infants who continued on ART, but mortality was high for those with poor immunological (low CD4 count) and clinical parameters (WHO clinical stages III and IV).
followup_time: At least 3 years (based on 3-year survival data)
